description: Email notification sent to admin when a parent requests transportation for a student
subject: New Transportation Request - $student_name
body:
Dear Transportation Administrator,

A new transportation request has been submitted through the Guardian Portal.

Student: $student_name (ID: $student_id)
Service Type: $service_type
Route Preference: $route_preference
Special Needs: $special_needs
Requested Start Date: $start_date

Submitted by: $sender_name
Date: $request_datetime

Please review this request and contact the family accordingly.

Best regards,
University Guardian Portal
